result:
I’d make **empathetic, long-term thinking the default in how people and institutions make decisions**.

Most of the world’s biggest problems—war, inequality, climate inaction, exploitation—persist because short-term incentives and in-group loyalty override concern for others and for the future. If empathy and long-term consequence were built into education, governance, business, and media, many other improvements would follow: better policy, less conflict, more cooperation, and more investment in things that benefit everyone over time.
